T:P1.9.text: Thryv ® helps fill your CRM with new customers, keeping your pipeline full and your team booked solid.

T:P1.10.text: Build a strong online presence, so you get found and chosen by more customers.

T:P1.19.text: We've helped local service businesses for over 125 years

T:P1.20.text: Thryv AI™: The Secret to Getting More Done

T:P1.21.text: Prioritize the leads that matter most. AI automatically scores each lead and tags every interaction by type, intent, and tone, so you can focus on the ones most likely to convert.

T:P1.22.text: Stop wasting money on marketing that doesn’t work. AI optimizes your ad spend to direct your dollars towards the campaigns that drive the best results. It gets more powerful over time and shows you your ROI every step of the way.

T:P1.23.text: Respond to customer reviews in less time and with far less effort. AI instantly generates three responses you can use to reply to reviews on Yelp, YP.com, Trustpilot, and 20 other popular review sites.

T:P1.24.text: “Thryv took me from invisible to #1 locally — the visibility has never gone down.”

T:P1.30.text: We'll scan your online presence and show you exactly what to fix to win more AI-referred customers. All for free.

T:P1.31.text: Thryv is an AI-powered growth platform that helps local service businesses get found online, win more customers, and grow faster. With software and done-for-you marketing services working together, you can choose how hands-on you want to be while AI helps you make the most of every marketing dollar.

C:S1.1.text: It is one of the largest digital and print publishers in America and its multiple iconic brands include PEOPLE, Better Homes & Gardens, Verywell, Food & Wine, Travel + Leisure, Allrecipes, REAL SIMPLE, Investopedia, and Southern Living.

C:S2.1.text: On July 31, 2025, Dotdash Meredith Inc. was rebranded "People Inc." Affiliate commerce commission revenue is generated when People Inc.'s branded content refers consumers to commerce partner websites resulting in a purchase or transaction.

C:S3.1.text: IAC completed the spin-off of IAC's full ownership stake in Angi Inc. on March 31, 2025. Angi's results appear as discontinued operations in IAC's filings.

C:S4.1.text: IAC Inc. is a holding company that builds, operates and invests in a portfolio of internet businesses across digital media, home services, care and search.

C:S5.1.text: IAC's main operating businesses are People Inc., Care.com, and Search, plus smaller ventures. IAC holds strategic equity positions in MGM Resorts International ("MGM") and Turo Inc.
